CustomField.description: The Apex class implementing this tool's @InvocableMethod action. This is also the name the LLM uses to call the tool, so it must exactly match the class name and be unique across all tools.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Must exactly match the name of a top-level Apex class implementing an @InvocableMethod action. The LLM calls the tool by this name.
CustomField.label: Apex Class Name
